title: NASA Water Insight RASI, historical (virtual Icechunk)
description:
A NASA Water Insight dataset ("RASI", historical) published as an Icechunk store with VIRTUAL chunk references into source NetCDF files rather than native Icechunk chunks. Unlike the 2.x bare-`repo`-object layout used by ctrees-agb-icechunk and gmgsi-icechunk, this store uses an older v1-style layout: a top-level `config.yaml` plus `chunks/` and `manifests/` prefixes (confirmed via a bucket listing; there is no `repo` object at this path -- a direct GET for one 404s). CORS confirmed on the bucket. CONUS bbox is estimated.

License unknown; declared "proprietary" with a via link.

Expected browser outcome: opens only if the Icechunk client in this browser supports this older v1-layout and virtual chunk refs; and even then, reading a chunk depends on the CORS/reachability of whatever NetCDF object the virtual ref points at, not just this store's own bucket.
